note: Facts the LLM may use, with source ids from docs/breeds_sources.md. Yields vary widely with management; ranges are as reported. Suitability (strong/fair/weak) is derived by the method in docs/breeds_sources.md, not measured.

Sahiwal.milkYield: about 1,470-2,270 kg per lactation; higher yields recorded under good management
Sahiwal.adultWeight: cows about 350 kg, bulls about 500 kg
Sahiwal.notes: Pakistan's best-known dairy breed; yields less than exotic breeds but copes with heat

Red Sindhi.milkYield: about 1,100-2,600 kg per lactation; over 1,700 kg after calf suckling under good management
Red Sindhi.adultWeight: cows about 340 kg, bulls about 420 kg
Red Sindhi.heatTolerance: high; also tick resistant and hardy
Red Sindhi.notes: Bullocks are slow but usable for field and road work

Tharparkar.milkYield: about 913-2,194 kg per lactation (farm herd average 2,194 litres)
Tharparkar.adultWeight: not found in the sources used
Tharparkar.heatTolerance: desert breed; no measured figure in the sources used

Gir.milkYield: about 1,200-1,800 kg per lactation (farm herd average 1,749 litres)
Gir.adultWeight: not found in the sources used
Gir.heatTolerance: zebu breed; no measured figure in the sources used

Kankrej.origin: Rann of Kutch, Gujarat, and adjoining Rajasthan; also kept in Pakistan
Kankrej.adultWeight: bulls about 590 kg, cows about 431 kg
Kankrej.heatTolerance: desert-tract breed; no measured figure in the sources used
Kankrej.notes: Valued for fast, powerful draught (the 'sawai chal' gait); large body

Rathi.milkYield: about 1,062-2,810 kg per lactation, average about 1,560 kg (farm herd 2,612 litres)
Rathi.adultWeight: not found in the sources used

Nagori.milkYield: low; no figure in the sources used
Nagori.adultWeight: not found in the sources used
Nagori.notes: Described as a good-quality draught breed

Umblachery.milkYield: about 494 kg in a 245-day lactation (about 2 litres a day)
Umblachery.adultWeight: not found in the sources used
Umblachery.heatTolerance: not found in the sources used
Umblachery.notes: Not normally found in Pakistan; a match is more likely a lookalike local animal

Vechur.milkYield: about 515-580 kg per lactation (about 3 litres a day)
Vechur.adultWeight: cows about 95-150 kg, bulls about 130-200 kg (one of the smallest breeds)
Vechur.notes: Not normally found in Pakistan; a match is more likely a small local animal

Holstein Friesian.milkYield: about 12,260 kg per lactation in US herds; much lower in Pakistan, where farm-born animals yield less than imported ones
Holstein Friesian.heatTolerance: low; crosses do better in cooler areas and are less heat tolerant than Jersey crosses
Holstein Friesian.notes: Highest milk producer but needs shade, cooling, good feed and disease control

Jersey.milkYield: about 8,180 kg per lactation in US herds; high milk solids
Jersey.heatTolerance: better than Holstein; Jersey crosses are more heat tolerant than Holstein crosses

Ayrshire.milkYield: about 8,580 kg per lactation in US herds
Ayrshire.heatTolerance: no heat-tolerance data in the sources used
Ayrshire.notes: Good udders, fertility and mastitis resistance; rare in Pakistan

Brown Swiss.milkYield: about 10,470 kg per lactation in US herds
Brown Swiss.heatTolerance: regulates body temperature better than Holstein in heat, but milk still drops about 7% for cows calving in hot weather
Brown Swiss.notes: Docile, strong feet and legs, long-lived

Cholistani.origin: Cholistan desert (Bahawalpur, Bahawalnagar, Rahim Yar Khan), Punjab, Pakistan
Cholistani.primaryUse: dairy (also used for meat and draught)
Cholistani.milkYield: about 1,200-2,000 per lactation (litres or kg, by source); peak about 26 kg a day reported
Cholistani.adultWeight: males about 500-600 kg, females about 300-400 kg (uncited figures)
Cholistani.heatTolerance: desert-origin breed; no measured figure in the sources used
Cholistani.notes: Thought to come from crossing Sahiwal with local breeds

Dhanni.milkYield: about 700-765 kg per lactation in government-farm records (one source says 1,000-1,200 litres)
Dhanni.adultWeight: not found in the sources used
Dhanni.heatTolerance: not found in the sources used

Lohani.adultWeight: small; bulls about 112 cm at the withers
Lohani.heatTolerance: not found in the sources used

Achai.milkYield: about 1,426 litres in a standard 305-day lactation (one study of 108 animals)
Achai.adultWeight: cows about 188 kg (smallest cattle breed in Pakistan)
Achai.heatTolerance: not found in the sources used

Dajal.origin: Dera Ghazi Khan district, Punjab, Pakistan (from Bhagnari)
Dajal.milkYield: low; median about 826 kg in about 203 days (2022 study)
Dajal.adultWeight: males about 480-587 kg, females about 380-400 kg
Dajal.heatTolerance: not found in the sources used

Bhagnari.origin: Balochistan and Dera Ghazi Khan, Pakistan
Bhagnari.milkYield: no figure in the sources used
Bhagnari.adultWeight: large; Dajal is described as smaller than its parent breed Bhagnari (no figure found)
Bhagnari.heatTolerance: not found in the sources used
Bhagnari.notes: Classed as a draught breed; about 1.5 million animals in a national census table

Nili-Ravi.milkYield: about 1,690-2,320 kg per lactation (weighted average 1,945 kg in about 306 days); record 6,535 kg
Nili-Ravi.adultWeight: males about 543-700 kg, females about 454-600 kg (sources differ)
Nili-Ravi.heatTolerance: buffalo: needs shade and water in hot weather

Kundi.milkYield: about 1,356 kg in about 219 days (research herd, 1976-2004); higher figures in breed profiles
Kundi.adultWeight: not found in the sources used
Kundi.heatTolerance: milk drops considerably in severe heat
Kundi.notes: Gives more milk in cooler periods and with canal water than ground water

Jaffarabadi.milkYield: about 1,100-2,340 kg per lactation (sources differ widely); high fat, about 6.8-7.7%
Jaffarabadi.adultWeight: males up to about 700 kg, females about 620 kg; heaviest Indian buffalo breed
Jaffarabadi.heatTolerance: buffalo: needs shade and water in hot weather

Murrah.adultWeight: bulls about 750 kg, cows about 650 kg
Murrah.heatTolerance: buffalo: needs shade and water in hot weather
Murrah.notes: Highest milk-yielding buffalo breed in India; widely used for upgrading
